description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 04.05.2015 to 01.05.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial/commercial transactions involving customs, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter (Type 5). While it names the Director General of Customs, this is only to establish authority for the regulatory action, not to announce a personnel change or assign detailed portfolio responsibilities.
